S15_T004.name: Frame sampling utility
S15_T004.tests: Own suite 13/13; required set 160 passed/1 skipped (frame_sampling 13, semantic_role_qa 16, visual_role 12, shot_mix 12, s14_t004 9, s14_t003 6, lipsync/hero_framing 73, s13_t005 14+1skip, audio_continuity 18). Full suite 90 failed/1812 passed/10 skipped.
S15_T004.implementation: New scripts/frame_sampling.py (deterministic local frame sampling for semantic-role QA evidence input). Two strategies: start_middle_end (3 frames at 25%/50%/75%), evenly_spaced (configurable count). ffmpeg-based, no paid renders, no AI vision. Primary entry point: sample_frames_for_render_unit() looks up render_unit/artifact from DB, extracts frames to output_base_dir/production_id/render_unit_id/, returns metadata (render_unit_id, artifact_uri, visual_role, timestamps). Does NOT create semantic_role_qa evidence (evidence-input only, verified by test). Errors: BLOCKED_FRAME_SAMPLING_VIDEO_MISSING/_CORRUPT/_INVALID/_FAILED/_UNIT_NOT_FOUND/_NO_ARTIFACT.
